turns.user: Tin tức công nghệ hôm nay có gì mới không?
turns.assistant_text:
Dưới đây là một số tin tức công nghệ nổi bật hôm nay:

1. **Eason Technology Announces the Formation of New Subsidiary**  
   Eason Technology đã công bố việc thành lập công ty con mới, Four Ele Industrial Intelligent Tech, nhằm mục tiêu phát triển công nghệ năng lượng và các giải pháp lưu trữ năng lượng mới. CEO Stanley He cho biết công ty sẽ tập trung vào việc cải thiện hiệu quả năng lượng và giám sát khí thải carbon trong lưới điện.  
   [Đọc thêm](https://www.manilatimes.net/2026/06/01/tmt-newswire/pr-newswire/eason-technology-announces-the-formation-of-new-subsidiary-four-ele-industrial-intelligent-tech-to-target-power-energy-energy-networks-and-new-energy-storage-facilities-scenarios/2355627)

2. **Tech, Media & Telecom Roundup: Market Talk**  
   Bản tin tổng hợp về công nghệ, truyền thông và viễn thông, bao gồm các thông tin về thị trường và các phân tích từ các chuyên gia.  
   [Đọc thêm](https://www.wsj.com/business/tech-media-telecom-roundup-market-talk-5bfe95d0)

3. **Defense tech darling Mach Industries hits $1.8B valuation**  
   Mach Industries, một công ty khởi nghiệp công nghệ quốc phòng, đã đạt được định giá 1,8 tỷ USD sau khi huy động được 300 triệu USD trong vòng gọi vốn Series C.  
   [Đọc thêm](https://techcrunch.com/2026/06/01/defense-tech-darling-mach-industries-hits-1-8b-valuation-a-4x-jump-in-a-year/)

4. **TechCon 2026 to Kick Off at COEX on June 10**  
   Hội nghị TechCon 2026 sẽ diễn ra từ ngày 10 đến 12 tháng 6 tại Seoul, Hàn Quốc, với chủ đề "Thời đại trí tuệ: Định nghĩa lại ranh giới giữa vật lý và trí tuệ".  
   [Đọc thêm](https://natlawreview.com/press-releases/redefining-boundaries-between-physical-and-intelligent-techcon-2026-kick)

5. **Lockheed Martin Opens NGI Plant Ahead of Design Review**  
   Lockheed Martin đã mở một nhà máy sản xuất mới cho chương trình Next-Generation Interceptor của Cơ quan Phòng thủ Tên lửa Mỹ, chuẩn bị cho một đánh giá thiết kế quan trọng.  
   [Đọc thêm](https://aviationweek.com/defense/missile-defense-weapons/lockheed-martin-opens-ngi-plant-ahead-design-review-key-test)

Nếu bạn cần thêm thông tin chi tiết về bất kỳ tin tức nào, hãy cho tôi biết!

items.title: Eason Technology Announces the Formation of New Subsidiary, Four Ele Industrial Intelligent Tech to Target Power Energy, Energy Networks and New Energy Storage Facilities Scenarios - The Manila Times
items.summary: Eason Technology Announces the Formation of New Subsidiary, Four Ele Industrial Intelligent Tech to Target Power Energy, Energy Networks and New Energy Storage Facilities Scenarios. The Company plans for Four Ele Industrial Intelligent Tech to extends its digital technology development to power energy, energy networks and new energy storage facilities across diverse commercial scenarios. Four Ele Industrial Intelligent Tech has been established to serve as a focused platform for the Company's strategy to develop, operate, identify, acquire, and license advanced energy technologies, with an initial emphasis on power dispatch control system and grid component loss monitoring solution. Eason's CEO Stanley He commented, "While improving the efficiency of power energy, energy networks, and infrastructure, the company views monitoring carbon emissions in the power grid and developing an auxiliary decision-making system for low-carbon dispatch as its next-phase development goal-an important direction also of global concern within the industrial sector.".

items.title: Defense tech darling Mach Industries hits $1.8B valuation, a 4x jump in a year - TechCrunch
items.summary: # Defense tech darling Mach Industries hits $1.8B valuation, a 4x jump in a year. Mach Industries, the three-year-old defense tech startup run by 22-year-old founder and CEO Ethan Thornton, has raised a $300 million Series C at a $1.8 billion valuation, the company announced on Monday. The raise nearly quadruples the valuation of the company in a year. Since building autonomous weapons is a capital-intensive industry, Thornton began actively fundraising a couple of months ago, he told TechCrunch, and quickly discovered that the round would be popular with investors. “We went out to raise 200 [million dollars] and we were extremely oversubscribed at 200 and happy with the price, so we decided to push up to 300. Founded in 2023, the growth of Mach has been a wild ride for Thornton, who famously dropped out of MIT at 19 to start the company. “So by the end of this year, in 2026, we will have brought on four new production facilities,” Thornton said.

items.title: Redefining the Boundaries Between the Physical and the Intelligent: TechCon 2026 to Kick Off at COEX on June 10 - The National Law Review
items.summary: ### Redefining the Boundaries Between the Physical and the Intelligent: TechCon 2026 to Kick Off at COEX on June 10. *Global AI pioneers and premier tech leaders to gather, spotlighting Agentic AI, Humanoid Robotics, and Autonomous Manufacturing.*. SEOUL, SOUTH KOREA, June 2, 2026 /EINPresswire.com/ -- A premier global platform is set to illuminate the core trends of tomorrow's industries, showcasing the convergence of the physical world and digital intelligence where systems autonomously reason, plan, and execute. The TechCon Organizing Committee announced today that ‘The 8th International Smart Technology Conference (TechCon 2026)’, hosted and organized by the Committee and sponsored by the Korea Tourism Organization and the Seoul Metropolitan Government, will take place from Wednesday, June 10 to Friday, June 12, 2026, at COEX Conference Room 401, Seoul. Under the overarching theme “The Intelligence Age: Redefining the Boundaries Between Physical and Intelligence” and the slogan “From Intelligence to Execution,” TechCon 2026 will closely examine the rise of 'Embodied Intelligence'. Day 1 | Robotics (Intelligence in Motion),.
